owner_request: Create mobile/lib/features/media/widgets/exif_privacy_modal.dart using Flutter Material3. Write a clean privacy confirmation modal (<160 lines) that displays: a security badge informing the user that EXIF metadata (GPS coordinates, camera model, lens serials, date taken) will be automatically removed prior to cloud upload. Include: toggle switches for 'Strip Location Data' (default ON) and 'Strip Device Metadata' (default ON), a 'Privacy Details' expandable section explaining GDPR compliance, and an 'Authorize & Continue' button. Ensure clean imports and no deprecated widgets.
